brief: The canvas displays a side-scrolling snowboarding course running horizontally across the screen. A colored snowboarder character moves down this course, following the gradient lines. The player controls the snowboarder using directional arrow keys to move laterally and the spacebar to jump. As the snowboarder progresses, the environment scrolls smoothly beneath them. If the snowboarder collides with the dark sidewalls of the course, the character immediately visibly recoils and shakes for a short period. This collision causes the snowboarder's visible health indicator to deplete, and upon reaching zero health, the game concludes.

statement: This sketch presents a side-scrolling snowboarding game where the player controls a character through a course using arrow keys and spacebar. The environment features gradient lines indicating direction, with dark sidewalls that cause collision detection when touched. The game includes visual feedback such as shaking on collision and a health bar that depletes when hitting walls. The implementation uses basic physics for movement and gravity, along with a camera system to follow the player as they progress through the course. The design focuses on clean visuals and responsive controls within the constraints of the p5.js environment, creating an engaging yet simple interactive experience.
